title: Why Your Local Business Website Is Losing Customers to Slow Load Times

segments.text: 43% OF MOBILE SITES PASS ALL CORE WEB VITALS
segments.narration: In 2024, only 43 percent of mobile websites passed all three of Google's speed tests. Timing check: 16 words / 2.5 = 6.4s + 2s buffer = 8.4s minimum → window is 7s. EXTEND to 0–9s.

BBC measured it directly. Every extra second their site took to load cost them 10 percent more users. For a local business, that means 1 in 10 potential customers is gone before they ever see your phone number. Timing check: 38 words / 2.5 = 15.2s + 2s = 17.2s minimum → window is 13s. EXTEND to 9–27s.

segments.title: Core Web Vitals Mobile Pass Rates (2024)
segments.narration: The bottom bar is what matters. Passing all three at once is what Google measures. Only 43 percent of mobile sites clear that bar. Timing check: 27 words / 2.5 = 10.8s + 2s = 12.8s minimum → window is 16s. PASS.

Save this if you haven't checked your site's speed score yet. Timing check: 12 words / 2.5 = 4.8s + 2s = 6.8s minimum → window is 8s. PASS. Total: 51s — Standard format (just over Express ceiling, acceptable given chart segment)
